journey.name: Create an account in Loopky, with no Pubky Ring at all
journey.description:
The route this whole issue exists for: a user who has never heard of Pubky gets an account without installing a second app.
Use the **invite-code** method so the journey costs nothing. Run it with Ring disabled, because the point is that none of this needs Ring.
The dangerous case here is not failure, it is a *silent second identity*: if signup fails and a retry mints a fresh key, the user's first pubky is stranded forever with nothing reporting it. The retry check below is the one that matters.

actions.action: Disable Ring: adb shell pm disable-user --user 0 to.pubky.ring
Enter a valid invite code and submit
Verify "signup_local_progress" appears — Loopky is minting the key and registering it itself, with no deeplink and no relay
Verify Loopky lands on HOME, not on a backup screen — signup does not stand a wall in front of the app
Verify the Profile card above sign-out ("profile_backup_nag") IS present: the key is only on this device, and that is where it is said
THE RETRY CHECK. Repeat with airplane mode on so the registration fails. Note the pubky in logcat ("registerKey: registering …"), then turn airplane mode off and tap "signup_local_retry"
Verify the SAME pubky is registered on the retry — a different one means a fresh key was minted and the first identity was stranded
Verify logcat shows no second Homegate request: the stored token is reused, not re-bought
BACKUP. Profile → "profile_backup_nag_action", then tap "backup_method_phrase", reveal the words, continue, and pass the quiz
Verify "backup_method_phrase_done" now shows on the menu, and that leaving it ("backup_later") returns to Profile rather than pushing a second home
Verify the Profile card above sign-out ("profile_backup_nag") is now GONE
Verify Settings → the backup row reaches the same menu, and that leaving it returns to Settings
Verify the phrase screen blocks screenshots in a RELEASE build (debug deliberately allows them so these journeys can capture)
SIGN-OUT GUARD. Create a second local account and skip backup. Settings → Sign out
Verify "settings_signout_unbacked_title" appears and that "Back up first" is the affirmative button — signing out erases the only copy of that identity
Tap "Back up first" and verify it lands on the backup menu rather than signing out
Restore the device: adb shell pm enable to.pubky.ring
